charts.definition: Row-level listed prices split by source, market, grain and currency. Quantiles use linear interpolation. Variant-heavy parents contribute more observations.
charts.denominator: eligible rows n and distinct parent_n per partition
charts.interpretation: descriptive convenience sample only; no market population inference
charts.missingness: exclude unknown measure; report coverage separately

charts.definition: 100*(reference-price)/reference; reference is merchant compare-at/original price, not verified prior selling price.
charts.denominator: rows with explicit currency, reference > 0 and 0 <= price <= reference
charts.interpretation: descriptive convenience sample only; no market population inference
charts.missingness: exclude unknown measure; report coverage separately

charts.definition: in_stock/(in_stock+out_of_stock), unknown or other status excluded.
charts.interpretation: descriptive convenience sample only; no market population inference
charts.missingness: exclude unknown measure; report coverage separately

charts.definition: Count observed rows per source parent and grain. Only variant grain establishes variant count.
charts.interpretation: descriptive convenience sample only; no market population inference
charts.missingness: exclude unknown measure; report coverage separately

charts.definition: Observed and missing field counts per source; null excluded from observed.
charts.interpretation: descriptive convenience sample only; no market population inference

charts.definition: Distinct source parent count by explicit source category; null category retained.
charts.denominator: one row per source parent; no standardized taxonomy
charts.interpretation: descriptive convenience sample only; no market population inference

charts.definition: Capture range and known source-update coverage; age can be computed relative to UI clock.

charts.reason: Need aggregate rating, count, scale and exact rating grain.
Visible public counters may exist but window is unknown; cannot compare sales velocity. Need documented counter window and grain; counters are not verified orders.
Need authentic dated keyword/platform series with market, sampling, scaling and provenance; repeated captures minutes apart are not trends.
Need seller/affiliate export with video/SKU keys, impressions, clicks, attributed orders, attribution window.
Need authorized realized commission, net paid orders/refunds, costs, fees and tax; public headline commission is not realized earnings.
